cluster_recommendation: The LaTeX/book cluster (latex-book, latex-documents, book-publishing, plus out-of-batch report-builder) has a workable division in principle — latex-documents for single-document/Beamer compilation, latex-book for arXiv/memoir conventions, book-publishing for the end-to-end swarm pipeline — but latex-book and book-publishing duplicate the same staged-agent pipeline almost verbatim with no shared source, so they will keep drifting (they already differ in how citation-index/research-verifier are grouped); pick one as canonical and have the other cite it. book-publishing also asserts no Gemini path is configured while GOOGLE_API_KEY is in fact set and consumed by art's nano-banana models — reword rather than assert a container-wide absence. Three of this batch's skills (latex-book, book-publishing, pdf-signing) are confirmed absent from skill-router/references/routing-table.md (zero grep hits each), consistent with the fact sheet's list of 38 router-table gaps — this needs either a real generator script or a manual backfill, since SKILL-DIRECTORY.md alone is not what /route consults. The image/video cluster (art, imagemagick, ffmpeg-processing, clipcannon) is well-disambiguated at the SKILL-DIRECTORY.md decision-tree level, but two skills silently assume unavailable capabilities: clipcannon's CLI is verified absent from this image (mcp.json says so explicitly; SKILL.md doesn't) and jupyter-notebooks' MCP server is verified never registered anywhere in the boot path despite a fully-specified 'Configuration' section — both should either be wired up for real or have their docs downgraded to 'manual setup only.' imagemagick's mcp.json note describes a retired skill-local Python server architecture that the master skill directory no longer contains (it now delegates to the shared agentbox-mcp Rust rmcp binary, verified present on PATH) — a small but genuine drift between the registry's descriptive metadata and the skill's actual implementation. typography, latex-documents and ffmpeg-processing are the cleanest skills in the batch: correctly scoped, honest about exclusions, all cited paths resolve, no stale model/endpoint claims.
